column2: Apple M5 Max, 18 logical cores, macOS 26.5
1920x1080 points at each capture's pixels per point; the view is Similarity2::uniform(ppp); precision f32 for lights, 8-bit premultiplied RGBA for tiny-skia

native and framed exactly as L-175 builds them (Capture::draw_list); tiny-skia draws the SAME DrawOps, each converted once, outside the clock, to a device-space tiny-skia figure: a rect without radius to fill_rect, a rounded rect to a path of four cubic quarter circles, an outline or ring to a stroke with round joins, a segment or polyline to a stroke with round caps and joins, a polygon to an even-odd fill

a rect that crosses its clip is cut to the clip; any other figure that crosses its clip is drawn through a Mask built inside the render, once per clip per band, zero except the clip rect's pixel fractions; an op wholly outside its clip is not drawn by either renderer

fixed = an empty list at the same viewport (the frame buffer allocated zeroed and freed, never touched); touch = the same buffer allocated, every byte written once and freed, in the mode's own threading; opsx = the list repeated 32 times through a view that moves every op off the frame; full = the list through the real view; pack = lights' handoff from its two float planes to 8-bit RGBA (serial: FloatImage::to_clamped_u8 then an RGBA expansion, the one path the crate offers plus the pass it lacks; parallel: one fused pass over the same bands), timed alone on the list's finished render; tiny-skia's buffer is already 8-bit premultiplied RGBA, so its pack is 0. page_ms = touch - fixed, per_op_ns = (opsx - fixed) / (32 x ops), ops_ms = per_op_ns x ops, px_ms = full - fixed - ops_ms. For tiny-skia an off-frame op is dropped by the band cull before tiny-skia sees it, so its per_op_ns is the cull alone and its per-op work (stroking, edge building) is inside px_ms
serial = one band the height of the frame on the calling thread; parallel = 16-row bands on rayon's global pool of 18 threads, each band a tiny-skia PixmapMut over its own rows

rep-major: every job once per rep, 7 reps after one discarded warm-up; each figure is the median over reps with min and max beside it; the render call is timed with its result dropped inside the clock

before any time is taken: lights' serial and parallel renders must hash alike; tiny-skia's banded render must paint within 0.01 of its serial render (band_paint_px against paint_px), and its per-pixel departure is recorded, not refused (band_diff_max levels at band_diff_px pixels), because tiny-skia is not exact under a band cut: a hairline, a stroke 1 px or thinner, loses pixels at band edges; either failure refuses the run with exit 3

frame_bytes = the render's own output buffers (lights: two f32 RGB planes, 24 B per pixel; tiny-skia: one RGBA8 pixmap, 4 B per pixel); handoff_bytes = the extra RGBA8 buffer lights' pack writes; ink_px = the sum of alpha over the frame, in pixels (every optical frame is opaque, so it is the frame's area and says nothing about content); paint_px = the sum of (r + g + b) / 3 over the 8-bit premultiplied frame, in pixels, lights' after its serial pack; vs_lights_mean = tiny-skia's mean absolute departure from lights' packed frame in levels per channel, vs_lights_far_px = the pixels where some channel departs by more than 64 levels
